name: use_session
label: RTH Session Gate
tooltip: Gate entries to 9:30-16:00 ET. Exits always run.

name: sweep_min_level_age
label: Min Level Age (bars)
tooltip: The swept level must have existed at least this many bars before being swept. Filters noise where struct_piv is short and a level barely forms before immediately getting poked.

name: sweep_min_wick_atr
label: Min Wick Size (×ATR)
tooltip: The wick beyond the level must be at least this fraction of ATR. Filters trivial tick-level pokes that aren't meaningful liquidity events.

name: use_smc_enhance
label: Enable SMC Confluence Enhancement
tooltip: Wraps structure/sweep/OB/FVG signals into RATE Mythos as a confidence enhancer — when a strong SMC rejection cluster agrees with a RATE signal's direction, the confluence threshold gets a small discount, same mechanism as TRC. Does not gate entries; only makes qualifying trades easier to confirm.

name: use_trailing_tp2
label: Enable Trailing TP2 (runner replaces static TP2)
tooltip: OFF (default): TP2 stays a fixed target exactly as before, zero behavior change. ON: once TP1 fills, the remaining position trails instead of sitting at a static TP2 — targets the portion of a move that a fixed exit gives up.

name: trail_kf_buffer_atr
label: Kalman Trail Buffer (×ATR)
tooltip: Each bar, the trail uses whichever is MORE protective: an ATR-behind-price ratchet, or a small buffer behind the Kalman filter's own smoothed level.

name: use_ltf_trail_tighten
label: Tighten Trail on LTF Weakness
tooltip: Reuses the 2m/5m regime-strength reads already computed for LTF failure detection — when both are soft, shrinks the trail distance so a weakening runner locks in profit faster instead of giving more back.

name: use_arm_window
label: Arming Window After RATE Flip
tooltip: ON: a RATE SuperTrend flip arms that direction for the next N bars — the confluence gate may confirm on ANY bar in the window, not only the flip bar itself. OFF: v1 behaviour (gate must clear on the exact flip bar). One entry per flip, never more.

name: arm_max_chase_atr
label: Max Chase From Flip Close (×ATR)
tooltip: Inside the window, refuse an entry if price has already run more than this far past the flip bar's close in the trade direction. 0 = no chase limit.

name: sess_entry_window
label: Entry Window (ET)
tooltip: New RATE entries only inside this window. The RTH session gate above still governs Market Profile / cycle modifiers; this one just stops fresh risk being opened into the close.

name: use_pullback_entry
label: Pullback Limit Entry (instead of market)
tooltip: OFF (default): market entry at next bar open, exactly as v1. ON: rests a limit order N×ATR below (long) / above (short) the signal close and waits up to the bar limit for a fill. Bracket exits are attached to the limit and go live on fill. Cancelled automatically if RATE flips against it or EOD arrives.

name: pullback_fallback
label: Fallback to Market if Unfilled
tooltip: If the limit hasn't filled by the bar limit, enter at market instead of abandoning the signal.

name: runner_mode
label: Runner Stop Mode (after TP1)
tooltip: Net-BE → Delayed BE (default, evidence-backed): after TP1 the runner's stop moves to the level where TP1's banked profit exactly offsets the runner's loss — the trade can no longer lose while the runner keeps room to breathe. True BE+offset arms only once continuation is proven (bars + extension below). Immediate BE = v2 behaviour (five independent tests show this scratches too many winners at a 0.33R arm). Net-BE only = never tighten past net break-even. Original SL = no change after TP1.

name: be_offset_pts
label: Break-Even Offset (pts)
tooltip: Distance beyond entry for the armed break-even stop. 1.0 pt on NQ ($20) covers the $4 round-trip commission so a BE exit still books as a winner.

name: be_delay_bars
label: Delayed BE: Min Bars After TP1
tooltip: BE cannot arm until this many bars have passed since TP1 filled (r/algotrading ES test: bar-delayed BE kept the long tail; price-triggered BE killed it).

name: be_extend_atr
label: Delayed BE: Min Extension Past TP1 (×ATR)
tooltip: BE also cannot arm until price has travelled this far beyond the TP1 level — the 'quite a bit of movement away' the evidence requires before protecting.

name: runner_weak_be
label: Immediate BE When Regime Is Weak
tooltip: Trading Rush (100 trades): BE hurts in strong trends but HELPS when the trend is slow/weak. If at TP1 the regime score is below the threshold, LTF health is weak, or volume-delta exhaustion opposes the position, BE arms immediately instead of waiting.

name: tide_be_after_tp1
label: TIDE: Break-Even After T1
tooltip: TIDE's runner (range-fade, small size) keeps the simple BE rule.

name: size_mode
label: Sizing Mode
tooltip: Fixed = Contracts input, unchanged (default so your baseline comparison stays clean). Risk-$ = contracts sized so the initial stop risks a fixed dollar amount (Kaufman: capital ÷ dollar volatility). Vol-regime tercile = full size when ATR is in its upper tercile, 0.75× middle, 0.5× lower — an ES/NQ momentum trader reported −40% flat-regime drawdown with no loss of capture. Conviction sizing (if on) multiplies on top.

name: use_session_bias
label: Enable Session Structure Bias
tooltip: Day-level directional prior from NQ's own 10-year statistics: before 10:30 ET, RTH open vs the overnight (18:00–09:30) midpoint (76% predicts which overnight level breaks first); after the Initial Balance (09:30–10:30) closes, IB close vs IB midpoint (82%/77% predicts which IB extreme breaks by the close), reinforced when the IB's last extreme agrees; after 15:00, the sign of the first half-hour's return (Gao et al., JFE 2018). Applied as a soft vote modifier, never a gate.

name: use_hour_breach
label: Enable Hour-Breach Timing Modifier
tooltip: nqstats (17,701 events): a breach of the prior hour's range in the first 20 minutes of an hour reverts to the hour open 67–87% of the time; in the last 20 minutes only 10–33%. When the entry bar IS that breach: penalty early in the hour, bonus late.

name: midday_mode
label: Midday Window Handling
tooltip: 11:30–13:00 ET has the smallest MFE/MAE ratios of the session in NQ's 10-year hour stats and is the practitioner-consensus chop window. Penalize (default) subtracts 0.5×avg vote weight from both sides; Block refuses new entries. The per-hour tracker (Time-of-Day group) will confirm on your own data.

name: use_event_blackout
label: FOMC-Day Blackout
tooltip: No new RATE entries in the window below on FOMC decision days (Lucca & Moench: post-14:00 repricing; CME: largest volume shocks of the year). Dates are an editable list — VERIFY against federalreserve.gov each year.

name: use_hv_open_block
label: CPI/NFP-Day Open Block
tooltip: OFF by default. When ON, no new entries in the window below on the listed dates (8:30 releases drive an unusually violent open — LSEG/CME).

name: tp1_split_pct
label: TP1 Share of Position (%)
tooltip: Percent of contracts closed at TP1 (floored). 50% on 5 lots = 2 at TP1, 3 run — identical to v1's split.

name: use_flip_exit
label: Exit / Reverse on Opposite RATE Flip
tooltip: A RATE SuperTrend flip against an open RATE position is the thesis being invalidated — close it. If the confluence gate also clears for the new direction, the position is reversed in one order.

name: use_eod_flat
label: Flatten RATE at Session End
tooltip: Closes any open RATE position at the trigger time below. v1 held positions through the 16:00 close and the Globex reopen with the full stop exposed.

name: eod_flat_hhmm
label: EOD Flat Trigger (HHMM, ET)
tooltip: Fires on the first bar whose CLOSE time is at/after this; the market close then fills at the NEXT bar's open. 1555 on a 5m or 1m chart = flat at 15:55. On a 15m chart the 15:45 bar closes at 16:00, so use 1545 there to be flat at 15:45.

name: eod_flat_tide
label: Also Flatten TIDE at EOD
tooltip: OFF: TIDE keeps its own 05-17 ET window logic untouched.

name: tpsl_mode
label: TP/SL Calculation Mode
tooltip: Fixed Points = current behavior (unchanged default). Other modes recompute TP1/TP2/SL price levels using the same TP1/TP2/SL slots.

name: use_adaptive_kf_r
label: Adaptive Measurement Noise (innovation matching)
tooltip: Estimates R from the observed variance of recent innovations rather than assuming ATR x constant — the filter self-calibrates to the instrument instead of being told.

name: kf_adapt_blend
label: Adaptive R Blend
tooltip: 0 = pure heuristic (old behaviour), 1 = pure empirical. Blended by default so a short burst of unusual innovations cannot destabilise the filter.

name: use_pe_weighted
label: Amplitude-Weighted PE
tooltip: Classic PE is amplitude-blind: a 1-tick wiggle and a large move with the same ordinal shape score identically. Weighting by window range makes structured large moves count for more than micro-noise.

name: dv_sd_mult
label: Divergence Sensitivity (SD of own distribution)
tooltip: Thresholds are now expressed in standard deviations of each metric's own recent distribution rather than hardcoded constants, so they self-scale across instruments and volatility regimes. Lower = more sensitive.

name: div_min_count
label: Min Divergences to Veto
tooltip: Only 3 divergence signals exist (RATE regime, Kalman velocity, PE entropy) — 3 requires all of them to agree.

name: htf_min_bull_for_bias
label: Min Bullish HTFs for MTF Vote
tooltip: How many of the 5 HTF connections must agree bullish (or bearish) for the MTF confluence vote to fire. Replaces the old fixed 2-of-2 ladder.

name: use_ltf_check
label: Enable 2m/5m Signal-Failure Analysis
tooltip: Reads RATE-style direction and regime strength directly from the 2-minute and 5-minute timeframes, independent of your chart timeframe.

name: ltf_instability_bars
label: 'Just Flipped' Threshold (LTF bars)
tooltip: A lower timeframe that changed direction within this many of its OWN bars is treated as an unproven / potentially-failed signal.

name: use_ltf_veto
label: Apply as Entry Veto
tooltip: OFF by default — informational only until enabled. When ON, blocks an entry if the 2m or 5m timeframe just flipped AGAINST that entry's direction.

name: use_real_ohlc
label: Use Real OHLC for Calculations
tooltip: OFF (default): script uses whatever open/high/low/close the chart is currently displaying — including Heikin Ashi if your Properties panel has Chart Type set to Heikin Ashi. ON: pulls genuine market OHLC via request.security, independent of chart display, and uses it for RATE's own ATR/ADX/flip-band (hand-rebuilt from real data — Pine's ta.atr/ta.dmi/ta.supertrend cannot be redirected to an alternate source directly), plus every other calculation in the script that accepts an explicit price source. Does not touch the 5 HTF / 2 LTF cross-timeframe connections.

name: use_rejection_cluster
label: Enable Rejection Cluster
tooltip: ON by default — TIDE's entry confirmation depends on this. With it off, rej_cluster_* is permanently false and TIDE can never fire.

name: rej_cluster_window
label: Cluster Window (bars)
tooltip: How many recent bars count as 'simultaneous' when combining rejections across level types.

name: expansion_confirm_bars
label: Expansion Confirm Window (bars)
tooltip: After a rejection cluster, how many bars to check for real directional displacement (Power of Three's Distribution phase) before treating the rejection as confirmed.

name: fvg_min_size_atr
label: FVG Min Size (×ATR)
tooltip: Gaps smaller than this are ignored. Previously any gap qualified, so a 1-tick imbalance weighed the same as a 50-point one.

name: fvg_max_age
label: FVG Max Age (bars)
tooltip: Gaps older than this expire. Previously they persisted indefinitely as 'live' structure.

name: use_po3_gate_rejection
label: Require Manipulation State for Rejection Clusters
tooltip: When ON, a rejection cluster only counts as confirmed if it fired during the Manipulation state — i.e. it actually followed genuine accumulation, not just noise mid-trend.

name: use_tide
label: Enable TIDE
tooltip: Fully separate from RATE Mythos — no gate, no veto, no toggle relationship. Always on alongside RATE Mythos when enabled here.

name: tide_confirm_mode
label: Confirmation Strictness
tooltip: Strict = full rejection cluster + delivery shift + Po3 Manipulation state (very rare). Balanced = rejection cluster + CISD/CHoCH. Loose = any one of rejection cluster, CISD, or CHoCH. Start Balanced; go Strict only if you're getting too many.

name: use_tide_poc_target
label: Use Market Profile POC as Mid-Target
tooltip: Targets the volume-weighted fair value of the range (where the most business was done) instead of the arithmetic midpoint. Falls back to the midpoint when POC is unavailable or sits outside the range.

name: tide_ext_mult
label: TP2 Extension Beyond Opposite Wall (×Range)
tooltip: 0 = TP2 stops exactly at the range's opposite wall. Above 0 pushes it further, chasing continuation beyond the wall.

name: use_vol_delta
label: Enable Volume Delta Exhaustion
tooltip: Feeds the trailing exit's tightening logic alongside LTF weakness — does not touch entries.

name: use_empirical_tp
label: Enable Empirical TP1 Override
tooltip: OFF by default. Overrides TP1 with a percentile of recent closed trades' favorable excursion. Falls back to Fixed Points TP1 until enough observations exist.

name: use_emp_regime_split
label: Split Calibration by Regime
tooltip: Keeps separate favorable-excursion distributions for trending vs choppy regimes — they are genuinely different populations, and pooling them produces a target wrong for both. Falls back to the pooled buffer until a regime has enough of its own observations.

name: emp_holdout_recent
label: Holdout — Exclude N Most Recent From Calibration
tooltip: Keeps the most recent N closed trades OUT of the percentile calculation, so they function as an implicit out-of-sample check rather than training on themselves.

name: use_tod_filter
label: Suppress Entries in Weak Hours
tooltip: OFF by default — informational until you've seen enough data to trust it. When ON, blocks entries in hours whose realised win rate is below the threshold over at least the minimum sample.

name: tod_min_sample
label: Min Trades Per Hour Before Filtering

name: use_family_confluence
label: Enable Family Confluence
tooltip: Groups the 12 votes into 5 independent information families (trend/momentum/volatility/statistical/cycle) and rewards agreement ACROSS families rather than raw vote count — correlated votes inside one family no longer masquerade as independent confirmation.

name: use_conviction_sizing
label: Scale Size by Pulse Conviction
tooltip: OFF by default (fixed size, unchanged). When ON, contracts scale with the Pulse's conviction reading at entry — full size at high conviction, reduced at low. Never exceeds your configured Contracts value.

name: kf_cold_start_fix
label: Kalman cold-start fix (v3.2)
tooltip: Re-seed the Kalman filter (including its covariance) until every input is a number. Fixes vote #9 never firing; see PARITY.md.

name: pe_na_poison_fix
label: PE na-poisoning fix (v3.3)
tooltip: TradingView: with amplitude weighting the PE bins are poisoned by na on the first bars, pe_norm is stuck at 0 and vote #10 fires on every bar. OFF reproduces that; ON skips the block until its inputs are numbers (v3.3 patch).

name: ltf_intrabar
label: LTF connection intrabar (engine)
tooltip: Which intrabar the 2m/5m request.security(expr[1], lookahead_on) calls return: 'first' = TradingView on historical bars (your backtests), 'last' = TradingView on realtime bars.
